When can we visit?

Monday–Thursday: noon–9pm
Friday: noon–midnight
Saturday: 10am–midnight
Sunday: 10am–9pm
More visit details

Do we need a museum ticket to play?

Mini golf has its own admission option. Choose the Museum + Glow Mini Golf bundle if you’d like both experiences.

What about parking and accessibility?

Free parking is available beside the entrance. For accessibility details or help planning your round, check our visitor information or call (346) 202-6006.

Can we bring a group?

Bring your people. For a birthday, private celebration or team outing, explore Parties & Events and get in touch to plan it.
